name: Build and Deploy Jane on WhatsApp to Azure VM (PROD)

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

# Same reasoning as whatsapp-agent's own workflow: without this, several quick
# pushes queue several parallel runs against the same mutable image tag
# (uriteam/urisvc:jane-whatsapp-reply-prod) — an older run can finish (and
# push) after a newer run already pushed, silently leaving the VM running
# stale code even though git HEAD looks current. cancel-in-progress is
# deliberately false: the deploy job runs `docker compose down` then `up -d`
# on the live VM — killing a run between those two steps would leave the
# service down. Instead, let any in-flight run finish safely, and only the
# single most-recently-queued run behind it survives (GitHub Actions drops
# the others), so the final deploy always matches the latest push without
# ever cutting off a deploy mid-flight.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python version
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run tests
        run: pytest tests/ -v

      - name: Log in to Docker Hub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        run: |
          docker build -t uriteam/urisvc:jane-whatsapp-reply-prod .
          docker push uriteam/urisvc:jane-whatsapp-reply-prod

  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Copy source files to VM
        uses: appleboy/scp-action@v0.1.7
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.JANE_WA_VM_IP }}
          username: ${{ secrets.JANE_WA_VM_USERNAME }}
          key: ${{ secrets.JANE_WA_VM_SSH_KEY }}
          source: "./app/,./docker-compose.enterprise.yml,./.env.example,./Dockerfile,./requirements.txt,./nginx.conf"
          target: "~/jane-whatsapp-reply/"
          strip_components: 0
          rm: false

      - name: SSH into VM and Deploy
        uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.JANE_WA_VM_IP }}
          username: ${{ secrets.JANE_WA_VM_USERNAME }}
          key: ${{ secrets.JANE_WA_VM_SSH_KEY }}
          port: 22
          timeout: 120s
          command_timeout: 15m
          script: |
            if [ ! -d ~/jane-whatsapp-reply ]; then
              mkdir -p ~/jane-whatsapp-reply;
            fi
            cd ~/jane-whatsapp-reply
            echo '${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}' | docker login -u '${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}' --password-stdin

            # Pull latest image
            docker pull uriteam/urisvc:jane-whatsapp-reply-prod

            # Deploy enterprise architecture (nginx + 3 webhooks + 3 workers + flower)
            docker compose -f docker-compose.enterprise.yml down
            docker compose -f docker-compose.enterprise.yml up -d

            # Cleanup
            docker image prune -f

            # Verify services are running
            docker ps
            echo "Waiting for services to be healthy..."
            sleep 10
            docker ps | grep jane-wa
